propositions: Plan-material-pin health signals (drift, enforcement posture, phase compatibility) must be exposed in detailed review surfaces (CLI show, MCP detail, audit, close errors, web UI) via a shared DerivedPlanReviewHealth contract without independent status string definitions.

Renderers must display canonical related tickets, normalized role, pinned vs current fingerprint status, missing-target state, enforcement effect, signed review phase, required phase, and effective execution floor using derived health semantics.
When pin enforcement is disabled, observed drift must be labeled as advisory and distinguished from legacy-unpinned state, while ordinary list output and persisted ticket events remain unchanged.

Audit rendering must call compute_validity at build_context/page assembly boundary, catch missing attestation or exceptions, and render derived-health unavailable as labeled failure without silencing allow/deny semantics.
Output schemas, rendering tests, and advanced documentation must cover plan-material-pin, phase metadata, rollout behavior, deletion repair, and validity profiles; basic user docs remain unchanged.
Detailed output schemas are additive and preserve rollback compatibility; detailed show intentionally includes plan_review_health while ordinary list output does not.
